tools.description: Format bytes as classic xxd-style plain-text hex dump starting at base_offset.
tools.python_reference: PlainHexRenderer with default HexViewConfig (bytes_per_row=16, group_size=1, uppercase_hex=true, show_offset=true hex base, show_ascii=true). Line format: '{offset:08X}  {hex_str}  |{ascii_str}|'. hex_str: bytes separated by single space, padded to 16 bytes with '  ' per missing byte.

tools.description: Format bytes as ANSI-coloured hex dump starting at base_offset.
tools.python_reference: AnsiHexRenderer with default HexViewConfig and dark color scheme. Output contains ANSI 24-bit color escape sequences (ESC[38;2;R;G;Bm / ESC[48;2;R;G;Bm). Verified structurally: correct len field, dump contains ANSI escapes, dump contains uppercase hex bytes DE AD BE EF.
tools.note: Exact ANSI escape sequence comparison is impractical from Python without replicating Rust color map; structural checks (len, escape presence, hex bytes) are sufficient for hardening.
